bundle.shortDescription: Character and covenant generator for Ars Magica 5th Edition
bundle.longDescription: A locally installed desktop generator for Ars Magica 5th Edition characters — grogs, companions, mythic companions and magi — as well as covenants, built on one shared rules engine. Offers a guided wizard, direct validated entry, and fully unchecked entry. Available in English and German. Everything runs locally: no server, no account, no telemetry. Saves are plain JSON recording your choices.
